===Specs=== *CPU: [[Intel Atom]] C3538 Quad Core @2.1GHz :(w/ AES-NI HW Encryption Engine) *Memory: 4GB (DDR4) pre-installed (expandable up to 32GB) *Drive Type: 3.5" SATA HDD, 2.5" SATA HDD, 2.5" SATA SSD *Max Internal Capacity: Up to 18x drives (with 2x DX517) *External HDD Interface: 4x USB 3.0, 8x SATA, 2x eSATA *LAN: 4x GbE (w/ Failover and Link Aggregation supports)
